The decisive mistake was made by VideoContentAnalysis_Expert at Step 1. It asserted, without any real evidence, that the first National Geographic short was "The Secret Life of Plankton" and that #9 was the Pacific Bluefin Tuna. It also claimed a 3 meter maximum length from the Monterey Bay Aquarium. The caption extraction was never actually run, so these claims were fabricated, and the answer of 3 does not match the correct 1.8. Later agents only echoed this result.
